Beyond the tasks measured

Every number on this page is for a named program on a named machine against a named Python version. The server results come from one run on each of two cloud machines; an Intel Xeon server measured Guion slower on an earlier build, and GitHub's standard runners no longer offer one, so that result is unresolved. The array and data-frame results on Apple Silicon were re-run on 25 November on a development build made after 0.9.0; the other Apple Silicon results were measured on earlier builds and have not been re-run. On that Apple Silicon machine Guion was faster than CPython 3.14.7 and free-threaded CPython 3.14.10 on all 11 small programs tried (array work written as plain Python loops, without NumPy, and short scripts dominated by start-up), and faster than PyPy 3.11.17 on all but one, an array loop where PyPy was about 2.5 times faster; the Python programs were single-threaded, so this says nothing about multi-threaded Python.

Overall competitiveness remains open, in the project's own words.
